name: Do-S Banchou
source:
"Whatever is yours is mine. Whatever is mine is also mine."
A Banchou who leads with a cold gaze and a biting mouth.
While bewitching maidens with his pompous and sadistic speech and cool gaze he resolves worries.
He's the older brother of Soothing and Maiden Banchos'.
